text.tspan: Grace has come as Christ Himself, my life and everything to be;
No more I, but Christ the Lord as grace is reigning now in me,
Grace divine infused, transmitted, Satisfies continually!
Life with Him is rich, indeed!
All-sufficient Burden-bearer, grace through weakness is increased;
Pow’r of Christ, through suff’rings, trials, tabernacles over me.
Multiplying grace, o’erflowing, from the throne of grace proceeds,
Timely grace for all my needs!
Universal masterpiece, the holy New Jerusalem,
Grace’s consummate expression—Righteousness, new earth and hea’vn.
Grace be praised and ever blessed!
